our_interpretation: The ordinary reading is substantial, systematic weaknesses in both understanding geometric concepts and drawing valid geometric conclusions. Isolated mistakes do not suffice.

Understanding is assessed through identifying geometric properties and relationships. Reasoning requires applying definitions or premises to derive conclusions; perception errors alone cannot establish this component.
The claim concerns mainstream general-purpose chatbots contemporary with the post. It does not assert that every chatbot fails every geometry task.

For this ongoing observation, use January 2025, the latest completed calendar month before publication, as the reporting snapshot. There is no standard reporting period for chatbot capabilities; February evidence is supplementary context.
The separate assertion about a combined system falling below a talented high-school student is not part of this claim.
criteria.support_condition: Reproducible evaluations of representative contemporary ChatGPT-class systems show substantial, recurring failures in both geometric understanding and geometric deduction. Reasoning evidence must include text-specified problems or analysis establishing invalid deductions independently of diagram-reading errors.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Broad, reproducible evaluations of representative contemporary systems show reliable geometric understanding and deduction across varied tasks, with failures too limited or exceptional to sustain the claim of huge gaps in both.

evidence.explanation: The January report finds GPT-4o accuracy of 77.86% on basic and 47.93% on advanced text-based relationship tasks, and separately analyzes failed deductions in GPT-3.5-Turbo responses. This supports weaknesses in both components, but the strongest model approximately matches the advanced human baseline of 47.79%; the experiment dates are unspecified.

Gemini formalized 30 of 39 formalizable IMO problems using a multi-call prompting procedure, with strong reported performance on easier problems. This qualifies any sweeping interpretation of geometric incapacity, but formalization is a different task and the report falls outside the selected snapshot.
